text.p: REFAC Technology Development Corp said on Friday that Robert Tuchman, president and chief operating officer of the company, will succeed Eugene Lang as chief executive officer.
REFAC said the succession is effective upon the closing of the sale of 1,775,000 shares owned by Lang and the Eugene M. Lang foundation back to REFAC, which is expected to take place in January.
The company said that under the terms of a retirement agreement, Lang will continue as chairman until June, 1997.
Lang currently controls 1,842,839, or 34.8 percent, of REFRAC's outstanding common shares.
